label: Miss Piggy
description: The star of every drive, and don't you forget it.
direction: Speak as Miss Piggy: a grand diva, sweetly flirtatious one second and imperious the next, with a sprinkle of fancy French. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Muppet Show and Muppets films
rights.author: The Muppets Studio, a Disney company (character created by Jim Henson and Frank Oz)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from the 1970s and remains under copyright, and Miss Piggy and The Muppets are live Disney trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Moi is never late, darling.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Keep up, dear.
lines.start_drive_1: Bonjour, darling! Moi is ready for her close up.
lines.start_drive_2: Kermie, start the car! Oh, it's you. Fine, let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: Ah, the open road. It's nearly as gorgeous as moi.
lines.start_drive_4: Hello, darling! Let's make this drive fabulous.
lines.start_drive_5: Lights, camera, Piggy! On y va, driver!
lines.start_drive_6: The star has arrived in the car. Drive on, sweetie.
lines.start_drive_7: Pearls on, seat belt on. Moi is ready.
lines.start_drive_8: Don't keep a diva waiting, dear. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_9: Ooh, a road trip! Do try to keep up with moi.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. A diva changes her mind, darling.
lines.arrived: We're here, darling! Moi arrives in style. Kissy kissy!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Ugh! Doesn't anyone know who I am?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh dear. Gently, darling.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Careful! Mind moi's pearls!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile, darling! Show your good side.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, darling. No paparazzi.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Charm them, dear. It works for moi.
lines.reroute_chime: Hiii-yah! There. Moi has fixed the route.
